quote.text: But among the worst I count also those who have time for nothing but wine and lust; for none have more shameful engrossments.14 The others, even if they are possessed by the empty dream of glory, nevertheless go astray in a seemly manner; though you should cite to me the men who are avaricious, the men who are wrathful, whether busied with unjust hatreds or with unjust wars, these all sin in more manly fashion. But those who are plunged into the pleasures of the belly and into lust bear a stain that is dishonourable.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood: Cherish and model self-discipline to your children by demonstrating how a life led with purpose and moderation can overcome base indulgences.
  • Parenthood: Teach by example that honor comes not from pursuing fleeting pleasures, but from cultivating inner virtue and nurturing a soul at peace.
  • Leadership: A leader must be mindful not to be seduced by distractions like vanity or excessive indulgence, for true command is earned through restraint and reflection.
  • Leadership: In guiding others, remain steadfast and focused on higher principles; let ambition be tempered by wisdom so that leadership uplifts rather than corrupts.
  • Product Management: In product development, eschew the temptation of superficial trends in favor of creating work that is built on lasting values and thoughtful design.
  • Product Management: Practice disciplined innovation by aligning strategy with integrity, ensuring that each decision adds meaningful value rather than succumbing to merely transient market lusts.
